title: The Island That Escaped
sentences: One corner of Europe escaped the Black Death, for about fifty years.
The great wave that swept Europe from 1347 never reached the island.
Even when Norway was devastated in 1349, the disease didn't make the crossing.
Iceland may have lost around half its people.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
